facts.value: Social media marketing can help promote a product or service and establish connections with customers.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Social media marketing can be divided into paid media, earned media, and owned media.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Using paid social media firms run advertising on a social media platform.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Earned social media appears when firms do something that impresses stakeholders, and they spontaneously post content about it.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Owned social media is the platform markets itself by creating/promoting content to its users.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Primary uses are to create brand awareness, engage customers by conversation, and providing access to customer service.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Social media's peer-to-peer communication shifts power from the organization to consumers, since consumer content is widely visible and not controlled by the company.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Social media personalities, often referred to as influencers, are Internet celebrities who are sponsored by marketers to promote products and companies online.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: The practice of harnessing influencers to market or promote a product or service to their following is commonly referred to as influencer marketing.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: In 2013, the United Kingdom Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) began advising celebrities to make it clear whether they had been paid to recommend a product or service by using the hashtag #spon or #ad when endorsing.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Social media platforms also enable targeting specific audiences with advertising.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: User content can trigger peer effects, increasing consumer interest even without influencer involvement.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: A 2012 study reported that communication among peers can affect purchase intentions: direct impact through encouraging conformity, and indirect impact by increasing product engagement.
facts.programme_association: Social Sciences - BSc | University of Limerick
